This '''female [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]]''' was the daughter of [[Kirana Ti]] and her [[Kirana Ti's husband|husband]]. When Kirana went to train at the [[Jedi Praxeum]] she stayed behind with her father. It is unknown whether or not if she joined the [[New Jedi Order]].
